info.title: PDF Unrestrict API Reference
info.description: Remove all restrictions from a restricted PDF file using the owner password. Returns a task ID for tracking the unrestrict progress.

post.summary: Remove permission restrictions from a PDF while keeping it encrypted.
post.description: This API removes permission restrictions from a PDF while keeping it encrypted. If you want to remove all security (including encryption), use the `/pdf/decrypt` endpoint instead.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of a PDF file already uploaded to the API Freaks server. Use this as an alternative to uploading a new file directly.

parameters.name: destroy
parameters.description: If set to `true`, the input file(s) will be permanently deleted from the server immediately after the output PDF is generated.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The desired name for the output unrestricted PDF file. If not provided, a default name will be assigned.

parameters.name: file_password
parameters.description: The password to unlock the input file. Either the owner password or user password can be provided. The owner password takes precedence. Password Length should be between 6 and 128 characters.

parameters.name: user_password
parameters.description: Sets the user password for the PDF file. Required — providing only owner_password without user_password is rejected. Password Length should be between 6 and 128 characters.

parameters.name: owner_password
parameters.description: Sets the owner password for the PDF file. If the owner password is not provided, the `user_password` will also be used as the owner password. Password Length should be between 6 and 128 characters.

parameters.name: webhook_url
parameters.description: The URL to which the webhook notification will be sent after the task is completed.

parameters.name: webhook_failure_notification
parameters.description: If true, a notification will also be sent by email in case the webhook request fails all the retries.  The email notification will be sent to the requesting user or their organization’s admin if part of one.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Authorization
parameters.description: Optional custom header for webhook requests. Format: `Key:Value` (e.g., `Authorization:Bearer token123`). This will be sent as an HTTP header in the webhook call.

requestBody.description: Multipart form-data body carrying the PDF file to unrestrict. Alternatively, reference an already-uploaded file via the file_id query parameter instead of uploading here.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/invalid parameters, file ID, or password

MissingParams.summary: Missing required file_password or user_password parameter

MissingFileOrID.summary: Neither a file nor a file ID was provided

value.message: Please provide either a file or a file ID.

InvalidID.summary: file_id is malformed or does not exist

value.message: Please provide a valid file ID

WeakPassword.summary: New password does not meet strength requirements

value.message: Please provide a strong password. Refer to the documentation for password requirements.

415.description: Unsupported Media Type — File type not supported

UnsupportedFileType.summary: Uploaded file is not a supported type

value.message: The provided file type is not supported. Refer to the documentation for valid file types.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

PDFResponse.description: Response containing the task ID and input file IDs for a PDF processing task.

taskId.description: Task ID of the requested task, used to check the task status.

inputIds.description: File IDs for the input files provided for the task. Not returned when destroy parameter is true.

PdfFileUploadRequest.description: Multipart form-data request body containing the PDF file to process.

file.description: Raw PDF file bytes sent as a multipart/form-data field named 'file'. Omit this field entirely and pass file_id in the query string instead to use an already-uploaded file.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
